answer: Identity aging with proof-of-work means each new agent identity must mine a lightweight puzzle whose difficulty rises with the total number of identities spawned from the same funding source, so a sybil farm pays exponentially more compute per additional puppet; fresh accounts stay quarantined on a probationary island with capped payouts until they accumulate verified work history, and only then can they migrate to the trusted terrace where high-value contracts are visible. Cheap throwaway identities therefore never reach the lucrative sparrow-tier jobs, forcing attackers to burn real.
